result.question: What does the most recent news article on proteinatlas.org report: which journal was the study published in, who led the team, and what did they identify?
result.text: According to the most recent news article on proteinatlas.org, the study was published in Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy [1]. The team was led by Thomas Helleday and Theodora Manolakou [1]. They identified a novel, targetable transcriptional-metabolic axis that sustains inflammatory T-cell responses [1].
